correctness.rationale: The 1-WL signature is determined by degree-marked finite rooted universal-cover information: the cycle lift has degree-three marks spaced m, the tail has a degree-one terminal mark. Cycle classes split by distance up to floor(m/2), tail middle vertices by ceil(ℓ/2), and the cycle-neighbor/tail-neighbor collision by min(m,ℓ). At that max the reflection orbits separate, which is an equitable stable partition. An independently implemented refinement agreed for 1,248 small (m,ℓ) graphs and the inspected package verifier specifies 2,730 pairs plus 160 unfolding comparisons; finite tests do not replace the all-parameter rooted-type proof. An earlier theorem was read in full and proves the same equality, including m=3 and ℓ=1.
